data.title: Malathion (0.5%)
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Scabicides & pediculicides_

**Class:** Organophosphate (cholinesterase inhibitor) pediculicide

## Mechanism of action
- Irreversibly inhibits acetylcholinesterase in lice → paralysis; ovicidal; residual activity on hair

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Head lice resistant to permethrin (age ≥6 years); pubic lice; scabies (aqueous lotion, some countries)

## Dose & formulations
- Apply 0.5% lotion to dry hair, leave 8–12 h, then wash; repeat after 7–9 days if lice still present

## Adverse effects
- Scalp irritation; alcohol-based lotion is flammable (no hairdryers/smoking); ingestion → cholinergic toxicity

## Contraindications
- Children under 6 (USA label), neonates; flammable

## Pregnancy & lactation
Limited data.

## Viva points
- Organophosphate — ovicidal; flammable lotion

_Sources: Khopkar ch.21 (Topical ivermectin/malathion); Wolverton 4e ch.44. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
